title: Report components of the focused project as a BOM text
summary: Iterates the components of every schematic sheet of the focused project with ISch_Iterator and reports footprint, parameters, pins and source-library parameters (IIntegratedLibraryManager), shown in a panel or written to a file.
phrasings: list all components in a project with their parameters
find a component in its source library
write a component report to a text file
show a report in a custom panel

commands.name: ProjectBomReport
commands.description: Report the components of the focused project as BOM text (pipe: returned; menu or panel: shown in the panel)
